title: Riding the Train to Ella: A Journey Through the Clouds
description: Experience the world's most scenic train ride and explore the lush green hills of Ella.
author: Tourvir Team
introduction: The train journey from Kandy or Nuwara Eliya to Ella travels through Sri Lanka's misty mountains and tea estates.

sections.heading: The Hill-Country Rail Journey
paragraphs: The changing highland scenery is a central part of the journey, with views across mountain slopes and tea country.
Allow enough time in your route to enjoy the journey itself rather than treating the train only as transport between stops.

sections.heading: Places to Explore Around Ella
paragraphs: Once in Ella, popular stops include Little Adam's Peak and the Nine Arch Bridge, alongside time to enjoy the cooler highland setting.
Compare Tourvir's hill-country and island-wide routes below, then discuss timing and vehicle options for the rest of your journey.
